entities.summary: Sixtus "Baggio" Leung Chung-hang is a Hong Kong activist and politician. He is the convenor of Youngspiration, a localist political group in Hong Kong that leans towards Hong Kong independence, and is also leader and spokesperson of the pro-independence Hong Kong National Front. He was elected to the Legislative Council of Hong Kong as a member for New Territories East in the 2016 Hong Kong Legislative Council election. Triggered by his actions to make an independence political statement during the oath-taking ceremony, he faced a legal challenge from the government and was later stripped of his office by the court on 15 November 2016.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Baggio Leung's actions as a leader of Youngspiration and Hong Kong National Front contributed to the escalation of the 2014-2015 Hong Kong protests, which led to the Umbrella Revolution. His subsequent stripping from office by the court had significant implications for Hong Kong's political landscape.
